<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('M','R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][-1][0],n['boundary'][0][1],n['boundary'][-1][1]))
    mx=0
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','g') and 30<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=35 and n['boundary'][0][1]>=16:
            mx=max(mx,n['boundary'][-1][1])
    out['tip']=mx
    return out
for i in range(3):
    res = action(['LEFT'])
    print(f'LEFT#{i+1}:', state(), {k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('no_impact','board_changed')})
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact'): break

</function>
